text: Server README: operator backup guidance for the SQLite database

Done. Added a 'Backups' section to server/README.md: sqlite3 .backup command (safe under WAL, no downtime), notes the -wal/-shm sidecars don't need separate copying, and that INVITE_HMAC_KEY must be backed up alongside (not in the DB, losing it invalidates outstanding invites). Verified against the actual connect() code path (db.py sets PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL unconditionally on every connection). Commit 31b9bf0.
